telemetry_source: Snapshot of app/engine/telemetry_generator.py for CDR Elena Vance; regenerate with backend/scripts/export_frontend_fallback.py. Used only by the offline browser fallback.

scenarios.name: Nominal Deep Space Cruise
scenarios.description: All core physiological, circadian, and radiation metrics operating within NASA-STD-3001 flight rules and the astronaut's phase-adapted personal baseline.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: CSA Astroskin 3-lead ECG + Smartwatch PPG locked; zero motion artifact.

scenarios.name: Systemic Infection / Acute Viral State
scenarios.description: High fever (38.5C) coupled with hypotension (80/50 mmHg) and resting tachycardia (112 bpm) away from exercise, signaling sepsis/dehydration risk in an immunocompromised space environment.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: Skin thermal array elevated (38.5C); requires sublingual/tympanic IR & anchored NIBP cuff confirmation.

scenarios.name: Orthostatic Intolerance / Fluid Shift
scenarios.description: Post-EVA or gravity-transition hypotension (85/55 mmHg) and compensatory tachycardia (108 bpm) with normal temperature (36.6C) and elevated PFO/DCS monitoring flag.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: Post-EVA doffing reading; seated/supine anchored NIBP re-check required.

scenarios.name: Severe Behavioral Fatigue & Circadian Desynchrony
scenarios.description: Multi-day sleep restriction (<4.5h for 4 days), suppressed HRV (21 ms), low REM (11%), and severe mood/cognitive drop (2/5), requiring immediate suspension of EVA/robotics per OCHMO-MTB-009.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: EEG/EOG forehead patch & HRV overnight telemetry verified across 4 consecutive sleep shifts.

reported_symptoms: unusual burning smell no one else notices
unusual burning smell no one else notices

scenarios.name: Caloric-Deficit Hypoglycemia & EVA Shoulder Strain
scenarios.description: Blood glucose drop (62 mg/dL) with <50% daily nutritional intake and sympathetic tachycardia (102 bpm) during high-workload EVA, combined with EMU HUT rotator-cuff strain.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: Interstitial CGM lag possible during active upper-body EVA workload; verify with capillary i-STAT.

scenarios.name: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Acute Radiation Spike
scenarios.description: Sudden proton flux escalation exceeding 0.50 mSv/h (0.68 mSv/h) correlated with NASA DONKI X-class flare / SEP event. Immediate radiation storm-shelter relocation required.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: Dual-channel CSA Astroskin + BLE Radiation Dosimeter cross-verified with NASA DONKI SEP telemetry.

reported_symptoms: light flashes in the visual field (phosphenes)
light flashes in the visual field (phosphenes)

scenarios.name: Contextual Confounder: Post-ARED/T2 Exercise Recovery
scenarios.description: Elevated HR (106 bpm), skin temperature (37.6C), and systolic BP (134 mmHg) measured 15 minutes after intense 90-min ARED/T2 countermeasure workout. Contextual AI recognizes non-pathological exercise kinetics.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: Post-workout sweat & arm movement reduced wrist PPG SNR (72%); skin thermistor reflects exercise heat dissipation.

scenarios.name: Contextual Confounder: Localized Cabin CO2 Pocket (4.6 mmHg)
scenarios.description: Mild tachypnea (21 rpm), borderline SpO2 (95.2%), elevated BP (132/84 mmHg), and fragmented sleep associated with a microgravity CO2 stagnation pocket (4.6 mmHg) when ventilation fan speed dropped.

measurement_quality.sensor_notes: Tempus Pro capnography & ECLSS CDRA telemetry confirm local bunk CO2 accumulation (4.6 mmHg).

environments.name: Deep Space Transit (Orion / Mars Cruise)
environments.protocol_focus: Wireless BLE wearables (no loose cables), cephalic fluid-shift BP compensation, autonomous edge triage.

environments.name: Orbital Station (ISS / Lunar Gateway)
environments.protocol_focus: Automated circadian LED lighting sync (16 orbital sunrises/day), full CHeCS rack integration (Ultrasound 2, MELFI, ARED).

environments.name: Planetary Surface (Lunar South Pole / Mars Habitat)
environments.protocol_focus: Mandatory lunar regolith / Martian perchlorate dust decontamination & airlock seal verification prior to active blood or cuff exams.
decontamination_checklist: Verify EVA suit dust-lock seal and execute 90-second electrostatic/HEPA regolith purge before opening medical bay.
Remove outer electrostatic gloves and cleanse skin exam site with sterile chlorhexidine wipe.
Confirm zero lunar/Martian dust particulates near capillary puncture or NIBP cuff sensor surface.
Reseal radiation-shielded glucose strips container immediately after removing test strip.

indicators_guide.name: Heart Rate & HRV
indicators_guide.device: Biometric Smartwatch PPG + CSA Astroskin ECG
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Keep wrist strap firmly anchored against the skin for 60 seconds; Astroskin 3-lead vest records continuous RR intervals.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Microgravity causes cardiac deconditioning and autonomic shifts. Combined HR spike + HRV collapse predicts systemic infection, dehydration, or severe fatigue earlier than HR alone.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Arm floating in 0g introduces PPG motion artifacts. Mitigated via 6-axis accelerometer adaptive filtering.

indicators_guide.name: Blood Pressure (NIBP)
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Anchor feet in restraint loops, rest quietly for 5 minutes, keep cuff aligned at heart level, and trigger Bluetooth measurement.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Loss of hydrostatic gravity shifts fluid toward the head ('puffy face, bird legs'). Post-EVA or landing transitions risk orthostatic hypotension and fainting.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Missing hydrostatic column alters baseline readings. Agent applies 0g vs 1/6g environment calibration.

indicators_guide.name: Blood Glucose
indicators_guide.device: Subcutaneous CGM or Shielded i-STAT / Capillary Strips
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Read continuous CGM trend or perform clean capillary fingerstick inside shielded medical zone (after regolith decon on surface).
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Spaceflight stress raises cortisol and insulin resistance, while appetite loss in 0g during intense EVAs can trigger acute hypoglycemia (<70 mg/dL).
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Cosmic radiation degrades chemical reagent strips. Store in lead-lined compartment and verify calibration hash.

indicators_guide.name: Body Temperature
indicators_guide.device: Skin Thermal Array + Infrared Tympanic Confirmation
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Continuous smartwatch skin reading is compensated against cabin ambient temp; confirm >= 37.6 C with infrared ear thermometer.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Closed spacecraft cabins increase opportunistic pathogen virulence while astronaut immunity drops. Fever >= 38.0 C with low BP demands sepsis isolation.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Cabin airflow fluctuations skew skin sensors. Software subtracts ambient spacecraft thermal drift.

indicators_guide.name: Sleep & Circadian Rhythm
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Wear actigraphy band and optional dry-electrode EEG/EOG forehead patch during sleep shift; log morning energy in chat.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Orbiting crews experience 16 sunrises/day. Per OCHMO-MTB-009, <4.5h sleep over 3+ days degrades reaction speed, decision accuracy, and mood.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Floating motionless in 0g mimics sleep on simple accelerometers. Requires cross-checking basal HR drop, respiratory rhythm, and EOG/EEG.

indicators_guide.name: Mood & Cognitive Load
indicators_guide.device: Conversational Sentiment NLP + Passive HRV Stress
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Answer the brief daily emotional check-in in AstraCare chat or smartwatch dial.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Prolonged isolation and 20-min Earth communication delay elevate anxiety and operational error risk during robotics or EVA.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Astronauts often underreport psychological strain. Passive HRV suppression + irregular sleep reveals hidden behavioral fatigue.

indicators_guide.name: Absorbed Radiation Dose
indicators_guide.device: Personal BLE Radiation Dosimeter + NASA DONKI Telemetry
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Continuous passive dosimeter synced via BLE every 60s and cross-referenced with NASA DONKI FLR/SEP proton alerts.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Beyond Earth's magnetosphere, Solar Particle Events (SPEs) can spike dose rates >0.50 mSv/h within minutes, requiring urgent storm-shelter relocation.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Sudden proton bursts require sub-minute hardware interrupts and haptic alarms independent of Earth ground link.

indicators_guide.name: Nutrition & Hydration Balance
indicators_guide.device: Natural-Language Meal Log + PWD Dispenser + QR Pack Scan
indicators_guide.how_to_measure: Tell AstraCare what you ate/drank (e.g., 'I ate 2 apples and drank 500ml of water') to update daily macros and space safety caps.
indicators_guide.why_it_matters: Fluid nasal congestion dulls taste in 0g, causing caloric deficit and dehydration kidney-stone risk. Excess iron (>10mg) or sodium (>3500mg) is toxic due to spaceflight RBC reduction.
indicators_guide.space_challenge: Busy schedules lead to skipped meal logging. Conversational NLP logging updates goals effortlessly.

cardiovascular.name: Cardiovascular System
cardiovascular.checs_device: CSA Astroskin ECG + NIBP Cuff + Ultrasound 2
cardiovascular.how_to_measure: Check continuous PPG/ECG on wrist, perform anchored NIBP cuff reading, and screen jugular flow or bubble study if PFO/DCS is suspected.
cardiovascular.why_it_matters: Cephalic fluid redistribution lowers plasma volume by ~10-15%, risking orthostatic intolerance and venous thromboembolism or EVA decompression shunting via PFO.

nervous_sleep.name: Nervous, Sleep & Behavioral Health
nervous_sleep.how_to_measure: Sync overnight EEG/EOG/HRV sleep stages, verify intraocular pressure (<21 mmHg for SANS), and complete daily mood check-in.
nervous_sleep.why_it_matters: Protects cognitive readiness, manages blue-spectrum CCT light exposure, and screens for Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS).

respiratory.name: Respiratory & Immune / Thermal
respiratory.checs_device: Tempus Pro Capnography + Pulse Oximetry + Tympanic IR
respiratory.reference_standard: NASA-STD-3001 Cabin Air CO2 / Pathogen Control
respiratory.how_to_measure: Measure SpO2 (>95%), respiratory rate (12-20 rpm), and compensated core temperature; inspect cabin CO2 levels.
respiratory.why_it_matters: Detects acute respiratory infections, hypercapnia from elevated cabin CO2, or Type II decompression pulmonary gas embolism.

metabolic.name: Metabolic, Endocrine & Nutrition
metabolic.checs_device: i-STAT Analyzer + CGM + PWD Rehydration Log
metabolic.how_to_measure: Check glucose (mg/dL), log meals/water in chat, and verify electrolyte cartridge values via i-STAT.
metabolic.why_it_matters: Prevents EVA caloric-deficit hypoglycemia, dehydration nephrolithiasis, and spaceflight iron/sodium overload.

musculoskeletal.name: Musculoskeletal & EVA Biomechanics
musculoskeletal.checs_device: Portable Ultrasound + Urolux Urinary Ca + ARED/T2 Telemetry
musculoskeletal.how_to_measure: Log shoulder VAS pain score after EVA/NBL suit work; run portable ultrasound if strength drops; monitor urinary calcium (<250 mg/day) and 2.5h daily ARED/T2 exercise.
musculoskeletal.why_it_matters: Rigid EMU Hard Upper Torso (HUT) suits cause 64% shoulder pain incidence (rotator cuff impingement / bicipital tendonitis); 0g drives bone demineralization.

radiation.name: Radiation & Space Weather Shielding
radiation.checs_device: Personal BLE Dosimeter + NASA DONKI FLR/SEP Live Feed
radiation.reference_standard: CSA Bio-Monitor Radiation Protocol & NASA ALARA
radiation.how_to_measure: Monitor real-time mSv/h dose rate, cumulative mSv budget, and live NASA DONKI solar proton/flare storm alerts.
radiation.why_it_matters: Enables immediate transition to polyethylene/water-shielded storm shelter during Solar Particle Events (SPEs).
